summary: On native Windows, stdio MCP servers launched via npx/uvx die before the JSON-RPC handshake.
evidence: claude mcp list shows server as failed; 'MCP error -32000: Connection closed' at startup
fix_steps: Wrap the launcher on Windows: command 'cmd' with args ['/c','npx','-y','<package>']
Run the exact command+args manually to see the real boot error
Run 'claude doctor'; use absolute paths if the binary is not on PATH

summary: At the context ceiling, /compact itself fails with 'Conversation too long', deadlocking the session.
evidence: 'Error: Conversation too long' or 'API Error: 400 prompt is too long' after /compact
fix_steps: Run /clear (or esc twice to rewind and branch)
Run /context; disable unused MCP servers with '/mcp disable <name>'
Trim large CLAUDE.md; re-enable auto-compact

summary: Long sessions or --resume on a large history exhaust the Node heap and crash the CLI.
evidence: 'FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory'
fix_steps: NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" claude
Start a new session instead of resuming a huge history
Restart long-running sessions periodically

summary: The API returns 529 overloaded_error when capacity is saturated; the in-flight task halts.
fix_steps: Check https://status.claude.com
Wait a few minutes and retry — 529 is capacity, not your config
Run /model and switch model (capacity is per-model)

summary: Auto-update fails with EACCES when the global npm prefix is root-owned, stranding users on old versions.
evidence: 'Auto-update failed: no write permission to npm prefix' banner on startup
fix_steps: Never use sudo npm install -g
Migrate to native installer: npm uninstall -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then the official install script
Or set a user-owned prefix: npm config set prefix ~/.npm-global
match_signals: no write permission to npm prefix

summary: Edits to hooks during a live session are not picked up; the old snapshot stays cached until restart.
evidence: Hook added to settings.json does not execute; no error printed
fix_steps: Restart the session after any hook change (config captured at startup for security)
Review loaded hooks in /hooks

summary: 'No such tool available' is returned for MCP tools that exist — usually a wrong parameter name or a first-call race.
evidence: 'Error: No such tool available: mcp__<server>__<tool>' though /mcp shows it connected
fix_steps: Verify exact parameter names against the tool schema
Retry the identical call once
Restart Claude Code to re-handshake

summary: On macOS, OAuth creds stored under 'Claude Code-credentials' are read under a different name, forcing re-login each session.
evidence: Login succeeds but next launch prompts OAuth again
fix_steps: Update Claude Code — the service-name mismatch was a regression
Temporary: run 'security unlock-keychain' before launching

summary: Over SSH into a Mac, the login Keychain is locked, so Claude Code cannot read its token and loops on re-login.
evidence: SSH session prompts for /login every time despite working in the local GUI
fix_steps: security unlock-keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
For headless: 'claude setup-token' and export CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN

summary: Half-configured IPv6 (SLAAC addr, no route — common on Starlink) makes every API call die with ECONNRESET while IPv4 works.
evidence: ECONNRESET on every request; 'curl -4' succeeds, 'curl --ipv6' resets
fix_steps: export NODE_OPTIONS="--dns-result-order=ipv4first"
Or disable IPv6 on the active interface
Verify: curl -4 -I vs curl --ipv6

summary: The filesystem MCP rejects paths inside an allowed dir due to symlink normalization — on macOS /tmp is really /private/tmp.
evidence: 'Access denied - path outside allowed directories: /tmp/... not in /tmp'
fix_steps: Use the resolved real path (/private/tmp on macOS) in config and calls
On Windows match drive-letter casing exactly
match_signals: Access denied - path outside allowed directories

summary: Playwright MCP sticks in 'Browser is already in use' (stale profile lock) and every browser call fails until restart.
evidence: 'Error: Browser is already in use for .../mcp-chrome-profile, use --isolated'
fix_steps: Restart Claude Code (restarts the MCP server)
Kill orphaned Chrome processes holding mcp-chrome-profile
For concurrency run the server with --isolated

summary: A transcript that lost a tool_result (interrupt/crash/corrupt resume) makes every request fail 400 validation.
evidence: '400 ... tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks ... toolu_...'
fix_steps: Retry once — transient cases clear
If every prompt fails, the transcript is corrupted: esc-esc past the broken turn, or /clear / new session

summary: --resume returns 'No conversation found' though the .jsonl exists, because lookup is keyed to the original cwd (git worktrees).
evidence: 'No conversation found with session ID: <uuid>' while the .jsonl exists on disk
fix_steps: cd back into the exact directory where the session was created, then --resume
Check ~/.claude/projects/ for the path-encoded dir holding the .jsonl

summary: WSL install fails with unsupported-OS or 'exec: node: not found' because the shell resolves Windows node from /mnt/c.
evidence: unsupported-OS error in WSL; 'exec: node: not found'; which node points to /mnt/c/...
fix_steps: 'which node' must be /usr/... not /mnt/c/... — install Node via distro/nvm inside WSL
npm config set os linux
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code --force --no-os-check (no sudo)

summary: One plugin entry with an unsupported source type fails marketplace validation and blocks installing anything from it.
evidence: '/plugin install' fails mentioning 'git-subdir' or 'source type your Claude Code version does not support'
fix_steps: Upgrade Claude Code (newer source types)
Install by full ID: /plugin install <plugin>@claude-plugins-official
Add the marketplace explicitly with /plugin marketplace add

summary: Piping into claude or running in CI without a TTY crashes the Ink UI (cannot set raw mode).
evidence: 'ERROR Raw mode is not supported on the current process.stdin ...'
fix_steps: Use print mode: cat file | claude -p "prompt"
In CI always invoke claude -p with the prompt as an argument
